description.name: Entry
description.text: [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Earth 10% (15s)], [Buff Wind 10% (15s)], [Buff Poison 10% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid (XIV)], [Chain Saw Damage Tracker], and [Chain Saw Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Earth 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Wind 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Poison 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Poison damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid (XIV)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Chain Saw (0~2), removed after using Chain Saw two times

description.name: Chain Saw Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Chain Saw level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid (XIV)]

description.name: Chain Saw Level
description.text: Keeps track of Chain Saw level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid (XIV)]
